description:
The process starts when an employee or department submits a request for an IT solution, such as new software or hardware.
IT assesses the request, checking for compatibility with existing systems and evaluating cost and resource needs.
If approved, IT procures the necessary tools or licenses, installs the solution, and tests it in a controlled environment.
After successful testing, the new solution is rolled out to the requesting department.
Training may be provided, and IT support remains available for troubleshooting.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_ITRequest" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/it-solution-request">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Request" name="IT solution request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Delivery" name="Solution rolled out"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_ITRequest">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Requester" name="Employee or department" processRef="Process_Requester"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_IT" name="IT" processRef="Process_IT"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Submit" name="Submit request" sourceRef="Task_Submit" targetRef="Start_Request" messageRef="Message_Request"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Delivery" name="Notify rollout" sourceRef="Task_Rollout" targetRef="Participant_Requester" messageRef="Message_Delivery"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Requester" name="Requesting IT solution" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Need" name="Need for IT solution arises">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReqStart</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Submit" name="Submit IT solution request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReqStart</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReqSubmitted</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Submitted" name="Request submitted">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReqSubmitted</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReqStart" sourceRef="Start_Need" targetRef="Task_Submit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReqSubmitted" sourceRef="Task_Submit" targetRef="End_Submitted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_IT" name="IT solution request handling" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Request" name="IT solution request received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToCompat</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Request" messageRef="Message_Request"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckCompat" name="Check compatibility with existing systems">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToCompat</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToCost</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EvaluateCost" name="Evaluate cost and resource needs">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToCost</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToApprovalSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Approval_Split" name="Request approved?" default="Flow_NotApproved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToApprovalSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approved</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotApproved</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Rejected" name="Request not approved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotApproved</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Procure" name="Procure tools or licenses">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Approved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToInstall</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Install" name="Install solution">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToInstall</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToTest</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Test" name="Test solution in controlled environment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToTest</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToRollout</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Rollout" name="Roll out solution to requesting department">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToRollout</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToTrainingSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Training_Split" name="Training provided?" default="Flow_NoTraining">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToTrainingSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Training</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoTraining</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Training" name="Provide training">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Training</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TrainingToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Training_Join" name="Training step complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TrainingToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoTraining</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToSupport</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Support" name="Provide IT support for troubleshooting">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToSupport</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Support" name="Solution available with IT support">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToCompat" sourceRef="Start_Request" targetRef="Task_CheckCompat"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToCost" sourceRef="Task_CheckCompat" targetRef="Task_EvaluateCost"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToApprovalSplit" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateCost" targetRef="Gateway_Approval_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval_Split" targetRef="Task_Procure">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${approved}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotApproved" name="Not approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval_Split" targetRef="End_Rejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToInstall" sourceRef="Task_Procure" targetRef="Task_Install"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToTest" sourceRef="Task_Install" targetRef="Task_Test"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToRollout" sourceRef="Task_Test" targetRef="Task_Rollout"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToTrainingSplit" sourceRef="Task_Rollout" targetRef="Gateway_Training_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Training" name="Training" sourceRef="Gateway_Training_Split" targetRef="Task_Training"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoTraining" name="No training" sourceRef="Gateway_Training_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Training_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TrainingToJoin" sourceRef="Task_Training" targetRef="Gateway_Training_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToSupport" sourceRef="Gateway_Training_Join" targetRef="Task_Support"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToEnd" sourceRef="Task_Support" targetRef="End_Support"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
